reading.body:
Pete Aguilar's AI record is mostly money: nine PAC contributions from AI and cloud companies, and four recorded votes on bills, with no sponsored legislation listed.

The contributions run from March 2025 to August 2026 and come from Qualcomm, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Meta, Palantir, and Oracle. Amazon and Google each appear twice, and the amounts are small and consistent, mostly $5,000, with Palantir and Oracle at $1,000. The donors are the companies that build and run the compute layer, chip designers, cloud operators, and the platforms that consume the capacity.

The votes are recorded as yea on four bills, but the data gives only bill numbers and roll call identifiers, not what the bills would do. Nothing here connects a contribution to a vote, and the page states that placement in date order is not a claim of causation. What the data does not cover is the substance of the legislation, any committee or sponsorship role, and any spending beyond these filings. It shows a pattern of donations from compute and platform companies to one member, and it stops there.

summary: Every dated AI event this site holds for Pete Aguilar: bills sponsored or cosponsored, recorded votes on AI bills, and money from AI company and AI-focused political committees, newest first. 13 events.
